items.title: P1 Architect: add a supported sensor-input binding operation
items.body: DEVAI 2.2.0 reads sensor-inputs.json but its registered init actions cannot materialize it, and adopter-policy rejects that field. Source: law/policy/scorecard-sensor-inputs.json. Add upstream support in a separately authorized task; do not hand-write protected configuration or patch installed dependencies. Acceptance: registered init action validates and materializes the adopter source with a digest, retaining thresholds and surfaces. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.

items.title: P1 Architect/Engineer: map DETRAN commands into supported sensor adapters
items.body: Cells F2:T4, F2:T5, F2:T8, F3:T1. Existing suite argv is refused with AUTHORITY_HOST_PROCESS_ADAPTER_REQUIRED. Native migration expects db/migrations, lint expects root eslint.config, and tsc expects root tsconfig. Disposable DDL/RLS smoke, workspace build/typecheck, and supplemental tests have separate evidence. Admit exact existing commands through the supported host adapter mechanism, map the ordered migration orchestrator, and preserve failure semantics. Acceptance: same real commands produce native readings without broadening authority or disguising scripts. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.

items.title: P1 Architect: make specification and plant measurements monorepo-aware
items.body: Partial cells F1:T4/T6/T7/T8, F2:T2/T3, F3:T3, F4:T4. Native plant scan counts 108 conventional source files; test coherence counts only four packages. Workspace inventory identifies 63 child packages, six frontend apps, and 750 test files including tool fixtures. Map domain-first roots, existing contracts and canonical specifications; classify generated clients before changing exclusions. Acceptance: explicitly documented complete denominators and no threshold relaxation. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.

items.title: P1 Architect/Engineer: restore complete canonical inventory inputs
items.body: Cells F2:T1, F4:T1/T2/T6/T7/T9. API sensor finds 1151 endpoints, but read-only runs do not persist the bodies required by dependent sensors. Routes/data-model discovery is empty; regeneration only rebuilds dependency/coverage bodies and reports missing prerequisites. Acceptance: authorized regeneration emits schema-valid complete API, Angular routes, SQL/data model, RBAC/data-handling and coverage bodies; dependent sensors resolve the same candidate and complete inventory timings. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.

items.title: P1 Inspector: enable full RC coverage producer and repair empty-exclusions handling
items.body: Cell F3:T2. Empty exclusions are admitted by sensor-inputs.schema.json but rejected as SENSE_INPUT_INVALID:exclusions. Compatible-input retry retains a failed producer; no whole-repository RC coverage report exists. Add supported coverage aggregation for the real declared population in a separate task. Acceptance: measured-file population and sidecar match all admitted source roots, exclusions are explicit, and missing or stale reports never imply coverage success. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.

items.title: P1 Engineer: restore supported dependency vulnerability observation
items.body: Cell F2:T6 is UNKNOWN with SECURITY_SCAN_NO_AUDIT_TOOL and SECURITY_SCAN_PREFERRED_AUDIT_FAILED. Diagnose the preferred audit command using the recorded transcript and registry constraints. Acceptance: a supported complete dependency audit produces native findings; network/auth/tool errors remain observation failures. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.

items.title: P2 Owner/Architect/Inspector: map targets and identify a supported performance suite
items.body: Cells F1:T7/T8, F2:T7 and F3:T7. No perf script or normalized performance/robustness targets were found by the installed discovery. First map existing specification and error-contract sources; only then ask the appropriate authority for missing targets. Pattern-based test-performance coverage PASS does not prove measured runtime performance. No new k6/mutation workload is authorized. Acceptance: sourced targets and an explicitly scoped executable suite, or an honest remaining blocker. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.

items.title: P1 Architect: triage harness and governance sensor findings
items.body: Cells F5:T3/T4/T5 and diagnostic decision/round-integrity sensors report workflow version drift, concurrency, missing/unaligned gate invariants, constitution entrypoint-version detection, legacy round records and decision citations. Current doctor, law-corpus and index checks pass. Treat compatibility mismatches separately from actual governance defects; preserve legacy records and evidence. Acceptance: each finding is evidenced and either fixed under its authority or retained with a precise compatibility limitation. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.

items.title: P2 Architect/Engineer: verify the sampled CI population and investigate duration
items.body: Cells F5:T7/T8/T9: native readings mark baseBranch unverified despite declared push/main filters. Sample: 89 runs, 87 successes, 97.75%; successful median 1684s and p95 2280s. Preserve native performance FAIL and historical population scope. Acceptance: API/adapter verifies all declared population filters, exposes the exact run IDs, and assesses duration under unchanged rules. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.

items.title: P2 Inspector: retain and investigate frontend timeout observations
items.body: Parallel frontend execution reported six 5000ms timeouts. Targeted RAIT and dashboard reruns passed with unchanged assertions and timeouts, under reduced concurrency. This is an environment-sensitive observation, not an established product regression. Acceptance: repeatable controlled reproduction or a documented resource/concurrency remedy; no test weakening. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.
